Real fixtures live in the repository that runs the arrays (picard-rs owns the corpus, so it
owns the paths and the constraints that go with them). This file exists so that a regression
in constraint handling fails here rather than being discovered later by a run whose rows are
The clause is real: Picard 3.4.0 throws 'FLOW_MODE is obsolete' on any row carrying it.

constraints.why: The reference rejects it outright, so every row carrying it measures the rejection rather than the tool.
